programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh? Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Andrea's Big Moment
programme.desc: When famous pop star Livi comes to Heartlake City to judge a talent show, our five friends Olivia, Mia, Andrea, Emma and Stephanie all decide to enter – and one of them, in particular, really wants to win but faces some serious challenge from an old rival. A talent show has come to Heartlake City and all the girls enter the talent competition hoping to impress the judges, especially their idol, pop star Chloe. No one wants a shot at stardom more than Andrea, which is why the other girls are surprised when she doesn't show up to practice before the first round of the competition. Very nearly eliminated prior to the big show, Andrea panics and throws herself into an intense practice-training mode, even shutting her friends out when they're trying to help her with her performance. Just moments before her live TV debut, Andrea realizes she's missing a key element to her act. Can she pull it off without her friends? And are the other girls willing to help after being pushed away?

programme.title: Kate's Island
programme.desc: The five friends leave for science camp that takes place on an island and during the trip, they meet the stand-offish Kate – but they soon realize that there's more to her than meets the eyes and that you shouldn't judge the book by its cover. No one is more excited than Olivia about science camp at a beautiful rocky offshore island with a lighthouse. But Olivia quickly gets off on the wrong foot with a mysterious girl named Kate who seems obsessed with a medallion necklace and the island's rumored history of pirates and treasure. Even worse for Olivia, Kate seems to be growing extra chummy with Mia, even sneaking around the island with her late at night. With the help of Stephanie, Emma and Andrea, Olivia is determined to get to the bottom of the girls' secret friendship and find out once and for all what they're searching for on the island, but they better not let Mrs. Stevens catch them out of their cabin past curfew.

programme.title: The Grand Hotel
programme.desc: The five friends help out at The Grand Hotel that Andrea's family just bought during what was supposed to be a quiet weekend until a hotel critic arrives unexpectedly. The girls are ready to do everything to make a great impression – but things don't quite go according to plan. Andrea, Stephanie, Olivia, Emma and Mia have come for breakfast at the fanciest hotel in town, now owned by Andrea's family. When Andrea's aunt has to leave town, the girls volunteer to run the hotel for the weekend with the help of quirky Grandma Jean. This is the perfect job for Stephanie's expert managerial skills but then the hotel suddenly fills to capacity with guests, including a hotel critic that can make or break the hotel's reputation! Now the girls find themselves in over their heads juggling reception, childcare, food prep and waitressing, a dog-walking service and a testy chef who quits on them in the middle of dinner. Unfortunately, much of this is their own fault. Can the girls save the Grand Hotel from themselves?

programme.title: Ninjaball Run
programme.desc: When the ninja learn that Darreth's Mojo Dojo is to be destroyed and Darreth doesn't have the money to save it, our heroes enter the annual NinjaBall Run to win its cash prize in order to save the dojo. As Lloyd continues to train and unlock his hidden powers, the Ninja learn land developers are going to destroy Darreth's Mojo Dojo unless Darreth can find the money to save it. The Ninja decide to enter their Ninja Tank into the annual NinjaBall Run cross-country rally to try to win its cash prize. Revisiting past characters who also enter the race, the high-speed derby will only grow more dangerous as Garmadon enters his Black Bounty, realizing this is the perfect chance to use his Mega-Weapon and rid the ninja. In the end, the Ninja will discover a few secrets within their Ninja Tank, allowing them to beat Garmadon's Bounty by a millisecond and saving Darreth's Dojo with their well-deserved cash prize. And as a final surprise, the Ninja steal back the Destiny's Bounty and make it their own once again.

programme.title: Child's Play
programme.desc: When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and turned into kids and are now forced to enlist Lloyd's help to battle the awakened monster. Tired of intense training, Lloyd yearns to play and enjoy his youth. The Ninja remind Lloyd that along with great power, comes great responsibility. When the Ninja interrupt Lord Garmadon from using his Mega-Weapon to ‘turn back the clock' and bring to life the fossils of a monster, the Ninja are accidentally hit and soon discover they've been turned into kids! Seeking Lloyd's help and relying on childhood antics, the five ninja kids must destroy the reawakened monster that's hunting them in the city. In the end, Lloyd makes the difficult decision and sacrifices his youth in order to save them from the beast, turning forward the clock and turning Lloyd into a young man. Sensei Wu fears now that since Lloyd is young man, the final battle of good versus evil approaches sooner than he had ever expected.

programme.title: The Surge
programme.desc: After a time of peace, the Ninja are called back into action. The spirit of the defeated Overlord has infected the electric grid of Ninjago and is using all available technology to exact his revenge on Lloyd. Nowhere is safe but fortunately, the Ninja have been given the powerful Techno Blades. But the only problem is that they have no idea how to use them. Time has passed since the Ultimate Battle, and while the Golden Ninja continues to watch over Ninjago, the other Ninja have become complacent as schoolteachers. When a mysterious invitation from genius Cyrus Borg brings them to the futuristic New Ninjago City, trouble surges when a digital virus of the Overlord takes over technology. The Golden Ninja makes a heroic entrance, only to find out his Golden Power supercharges the enemy. Sensei Wu stays behind so that the Ninja can escape with the only thing that can save Ninjago's future – Borg's Techno Weapons.

programme.title: The Art Of The Silent Fist
programme.desc: The Ninja go into hiding but an army of the Digtial Overlord's evil robotic Nindroids are hunting them wherever they go. Their only chance is to learn the secrets of the Techno blades and use them to cut all power to save Ninjao from this technological menace. The Ninja hide out at a safe place void of technology – Sensei Garmadon's Sanctuary. That night, Zane is visited by Borg's female robo-assistant, Pixal. She warns them that the Digital Overlord is after Lloyd's Golden Power in order to become flesh, but the Techno Blades can reboot the system and erase him for good. After a highly advanced army of Nindroids attacks the Sanctuary, Lloyd flees with his father into the wilderness of Ninjago, while the rest set off on a quest to turn off all power in Ninjago, so that they can erase the Digital Overlord once and for all.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a Tsar with his three sons. The oldest son married on nobleman's daughter, the second one married the merchant's daughter, while the youngest son - on the Frog. She was not pretty, but happened to be the Frog Princess who turned into a beautiful girl. This story teaches us to take care of your pets. This is the only way they could appeal to your concerns and become your faithful friends.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This tale tells us about one Caliph from the East, who used to sit all day long in front of the window and listen to the birds chirping. Caliph was very powerful, but there was one thing that disappointed him - he could not understand the birds' language. Poor Caliph began to cry and no one was able to make him laugh. One day a strange dwarf came to Caliph. He promised to help him to turn him into a stork. Caliph agreed and turned into a stork. Meanwhile, the dwarf sat on the throne and proclaimed himself Caliph. The poor Stork burst into tears and begged the dwarf to restore his human appearance and kingship. Nothing would have saved Caliph, if only one little parrot helped Caliph to bewitch the dwarf and return the human appearance to him. Masha concludes that it is very important to learn foreign languages.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There lived a boy called Jack. He was so poor that no girl would want to marry him. One day he went to the market to sell the cow and buy himself a suit. On his way to the market Jack met an old man, who offered him to buy a cow for a bean seed. Jack agreed and went home. There he met his mother, who realized that money was spent for nothing and threw away the seed out from the window. At night, when Jack and his mother were sleeping, the seed sprouted and grew into a tall tree. In the morning, Jack has decided to climb this tree. He attempted several times but each time he fell down. Suddenly he noticed a saw a plait hanging next to him from the tree. He pulled it down and suddenly a beautiful girl fell right into his arms. They got married and lived happily ever after. To conclude, only selfless deeds can bring true happiness.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there was a king. He was very cranky and foolish. One day he wished to taste an exotic fowl and sent Yegor the huntsman to the deep forest. In the forest, Yegor met a starling, which turned into a beautiful girl. The Tsar saw Yegor to have successfully completed his task and also got the beautiful wife. He started to envy Yegor. The Tsar decided to send Yegor over distant seas to bring do not know what. Despite Tsar's insidious plan, Yegor has successfully returned back home and even taught the king an important lesson not to envy other people.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This fairy tale is about one little and witty tailor, who had a chance to defeat the giant and obtain a fridge full of sweets. So he ate all of them at once. This story teaches us a vital lesson not to be greedy and eat too much otherwise we might get into a messy situation.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

Rachel is 8 and for the first time is allowed to join her brothers and sister to visit their grandfather, Amos, as he carries out his annual ritual of a night in the hills, where he worked as a young shepherd boy. Grandfather is delighted to see the children and a special bond is established between him and Rachel. He tells them how she reminds him of a magical night he then proceeds to recount it. He explains how, ahead of the other shepherds protecting their flock with him, he is flown away by the Angel Gabriel, to be the first visitor to the newly born Christ child. This magical re-working of the nativity by the leading writer Michael Morpurgo (War Horse, Private Peaceful) is rich with human poignancy as we share this very special experience.

programme.title: 12 Days Of Giving
programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.title: Saving Santa
programme.desc: Once upon a time, Santa operated with just a small workshop and a few elves. But, as Christmas has grown ever bigger, Santa has been forced to innovate! Now his cleverest elves develop amazing technology, including a hologram to hide the North Pole and a time machine to allow Santa to deliver presents to every home in the world, in just the one night. Bernard is an elf who dreams of creating such inventions, but his job is to clean the reindeer stables! Yet when he creates an amazing Christmas memory machine, his luck might be changing. But Bernard's invention is broken by a curious elf, causing the North Pole's power to fail and the hologram hiding it to disappear. Now exposed to the outside world, it is spotted by Santa's enemy, Neville Baddington, who is determined to steal Santa's secrets for himself. The only person who can stop him is Bernard.

programme.title: The Magic Reindeer: The Flight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Niko the Reindeer enjoys his cool and carefree life in the Arctic, but that all changes when he is given his most surprising Christmas present ever - a little stepbrother named Jonni! Niko is unhappy about this new addition to the family, but when Jonni is kidnapped by eagles, Niko realises that it's down to him to fly off and rescue his brother!

programme.title: Crossing the Line
programme.desc: From the team behind Oscar winners La La Land and Call Me by Your Name. This modern Western showcases breathtaking performances by Tessa Thompson and Lily James, who portray sisters forced into a life of crime to save their family. Faced with betrayal and violence, they risk everything on a drug smuggling mission. A brutally fresh look at all of Americas ills. Winters Bone meets Frozen River.

programme.title: All Roads Lead To Rome

An unmissable, feel-good rom-com with a stellar cast. Not to be missed!

All is well until a new charge brings the witch hunters to their door. Will they also be charged with the ungodly crime of being a witch?

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA

Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.17
programme.desc: Upon discovering that Jeongi is Euldam's daughter, Gangcheon expels her from the Bunwon workshop. In front of everyone, Mun Saseung kneels and begs Gangcheon to spare her. When Hwa-ryeong declares that she will live solely to defeat Jeongi, Taedo is left shaken. Soon after, Jeongi is ordered to craft a porcelain vase as a birthday gift for Royal Consort Inbin, and Gwanghae promises to support her with everything he has.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.18
programme.desc: Startled by the sound of vases shattering inside the kiln, Jeongi peers inside and suddenly collapses. Hearing that Jeongi had been guarding the kiln alone, Gwanghae turns pale and desperately searches for her. Taedo watches over the unconscious Jeongi with quiet anguish. Seeing Jeongi injured, her eyesight damaged, Gwanghae is overcome with pain—yet Jeongi asks only to be allowed back into the Bunwon.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.19
programme.desc: Claiming she has no lingering attachment, Jeongi leaves the Bunwon behind, and Gwanghae watches her go in hollow disbelief. After returning to her former home, Jeongi and Taedo are suddenly seized by military officers, who drag Taedo away. Gwanghae pleads with Inbin to release him, insisting that Taedo once served as his personal guard. Awakened by her mother Yeonok's voice, Jeongi rises and walks toward the kiln…

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.20
programme.desc: King Seonjo orders Gwanghae, Imhae, and Shinseong to find a way to end the people's widespread stomach illness, prompting Gwanghae to disguise himself and investigate in secret. While surveying the village, he unexpectedly encounters Jeongi, who is making and distributing bowls to the villagers. Jeongi carefully presents a vessel she crafted especially for Gwanghae. Soon, a royal decree is issued for the Bunwon to produce pottery for the common people, and Gwanghae sets out to find Jeongi.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.21
programme.desc: Despite Taedo's warnings that it is dangerous, Jeongi insists she must remain at the Bunwon to bring Gangcheon down from his nangcheong post. Reunited with Jeongi at the workshop, Gwanghae cannot hide his quiet delight. Meanwhile, Yukdo grows uneasy when he is forced to compete with Jeongi to create the lid for King Seonjo's cherished jar. He promises Jeongi that if she succeeds, he will elevate her to the rank of master potter.

programme.title: Goddess of Fire Ep.22
programme.desc: When King Seonjo selects Yukdo's lid, Yukdo struggles to contain his joy, while Jeongi graciously acknowledges his skill. Gwanghae petitions the king to lift the Chief Scholar's exile, but Seonjo misinterprets the request as a threat to royal authority. Seizing the moment, Inbin plots to frame Gwanghae for treason by forging his letter. As Jeongi departs on Gangcheon's errand to mine white clay, Gwanghae mounts his horse and races after her.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is risking city-pop songwriter nokdu! nokdu made his big debut in 2018 with the single Say My Name. As a graduate of The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts founded by Paul McCartney and Mark Featherstone-Witty he covers a wide range of genres in his music ranging from Brit-pop to punk to R&B. Backed up by his academic background he boasts his outstanding ability not only as a songwriter but also a lyricist producer and singer. Also known for his stage manners he is quickly capturing the ears and souls of countless listeners. Currently he's taking part in the competition program Super Band 2. His fantastic performance in the show definitely makes us anticipate his future as a musician. In this episode nokdu performs Stay With Me Wona and more to show off the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the sensual pop-duo WeAreYoung! Composed of keyboardist and vocalist KIM Kyung-min and guitarist and vocalist GU Ki-hoon this duo made themselves known to the public with their heartfelt songs about youth and love. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they won the 2017 Shinhan Card Rookie Award the Silver Prize at the 2017 Martin Contest and Best Rookie at the Beautiful Mint Life 2018. This year they were chosen as recipients of the MUSE ON 2021 which aims to connect musicians and fans during the COVID-19 pandemic. Earlier this year WeAreYoung announced their much-anticipated comeback after completing their mandatory military duties and they are bound to impress once again with their songs A Day Full Of You Let's not do that Only I Love You and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of Christmas Special Year-End Special and New-Year Special and the guest of the Christmas Special Episode is Lee Jin ah. Lee Jin ah is a pop/jazz singer-songwriter known for her exceptional piano playing and composition capabilities. Her jazz-based music covering pop R&B hip-hop ballads and more has long been supported with enthusiasm by the public and also by fellow musicians and she always comforts the hearts of listeners with her genuine heartfelt message. In an effort to widen her artistry she made her debut as a film music director in May this year she made her debut as a film music director with Kids Are Fine. In this Christmas special edition Lee Jin ah performs The Wall Blocks Me Noisily Everywhere Awake Yum Yum Yum and her own version of Santa Claus Is Coming To Town. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: La tratta delle bianche

Rosario Scimoni, detto Sasà, è una persona opportunista e senza scrupoli, nipote del sindaco di Catania, sempre pronto a schierarsi con chiunque possa aiutarlo. Passa dal socialismo al fascismo, cambiando fede politica con la stessa facilità con cui cambia le donne. Prova addirittura a fondare un proprio partito. Diretto da Luigi Zampa.

programme.title: Il Federale
programme.desc: Negli ultimi giorni del fascismo, un miliziano zelante riceve l'ordine di catturare un professore antifascista e portarlo a Roma. Il viaggio attraverso un'Italia in disfacimento cambierà progressivamente le sue certezze.

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: Splendor
programme.desc: Il proprietario, il proiezionista e la maschera di una sala di provincia che sta per chiudere i battenti si abbandonano ai ricordi: ma quando gli operai stanno già schiodando le poltrone...

programme.title: Allonsanfan
programme.desc: 1816. Nell`Europa della Restaurazione, Fulvio Imbriani, un prigioniero politico aristocratico, ex giacobino ed ex ufficiale napoleonico, esce dal carcere e fa ritorno alla proprietà di famiglia. I suoi ex compagni di lotta fanno di tutto per coinvolgerlo nuovamente in azioni rivoluzionarie, ma lui è riluttante e sfiduciato. Finché si butta a capofitto in una rovinosa spedizione al Sud...

programme.title: Piccolo mondo antico
programme.desc: Durante il Risorgimento, un giovane di nobile casato sposa, contro il volere della nonna austricante, una donna borghese e va a vivere sul lago di Como. La loro bambina annega per una svista fatale, e la giovane madre quasi impazzisce. Si riprende solo quando lo sposo, che intanto ha aderito ai movimenti clandestini rivoluzionari, annuncia la sua partenza per la guerra di Crimea.

programme.title: Spore

Convinto di trovare immediatamente un altro lavoro all'altezza del suo curriculum, dopo oltre due anni di ricerche si ritrova ancora disoccupato. Decide così di mettere in atto un piano destinato a restituirgli il lavoro presso la principale azienda del settore, la Arcadia. Il piano consiste nell'eliminazione fisica di tutti i suoi principali concorrenti, altri manager che come lui hanno perso il posto e vivono di espedienti partecipando ad umilianti colloqui di lavoro.

programme.desc: Olivia, la maestra di danza, seleziona Lily per il saggio di Natale. Ben presto, però, si trova a innamorarsi di Michael, il padre della ragazzina. La sua vita è a un bivio, seguire il cuore o tornare in Florida?

programme.title: Life like
programme.desc: James e Sophie si trasferiscono in periferia. Sophie decide di licenziare il personale di servizio. James la convince a sostituirlo con un androide e lei sceglie Henry. Tutto è perfetto finché il cervello di Henry evolve, cominciando a provare emozioni.

programme.title: Bad blood
programme.desc: Hannah è bionda, carina e incastrata in una vita buia e sporca, fatta di droghe, spaccio e illegalità in tutte le sue declinazioni. Sulle sue spalle, grava la responsabilità dell'intera famiglia, coinvolta in affari illeciti e amori impossibili.

programme.title: Crazy In Love
programme.desc: Donald e Isabel sono affetti dalla sindrome di Asperger. Gli stravolgerà la vita e lui non potrà che innamorarsene perdutamente.

programme.title: Restiamo Amici
programme.desc: Alessandro viene improvvisamente contattato, dal Brasile, dal suo vecchio amico Gigi. In punto di morte, l'uomo ha un ultimo favore: per ereditare i tre milioni di euro che gli ha lasciato suo padre deve intestarli a suo figlio. Ma Gigi non ha eredi.

programme.title: Gold
programme.desc: Due uomini si imbattono nella più grande pepita d'oro mai trovata nel deserto. Dovranno escogitare un piano per scavare l'oro, cercando al tempo stesso di proteggere la scoperta da sguardi indiscreti.

programme.title: L'eroe
programme.desc: Un giornalista ambizioso ma mediocre viene relegato a una redazione di provincia e poi licenziato. Quando il nipote di una potente imprenditrice viene rapito, torna al centro della scena. Tra scoop e paure collettive, il paese cerca un colpevole.

programme.title: Quel momento imbarazzante
programme.desc: Tre migliori amici si fanno una promessa: quella di restare tutti single. Hanno infatti timore che le relazioni serie possano annullare le loro personalità e far cambiare il loro rapporto di amicizia. Nel momento in cui meno se lo aspettano però tre ragazze gli faranno cambiare idea.

programme.title: Queen of the desert
programme.desc: Non c'era un marito buono per Gertrude Bell in tutta l'Inghilterra. Troppo sveglia, curiosa, acculturata, intelligente e troppo poco disposta a nascondere queste qualitá per accasarsi. Solo fuori dai confini del suo paese, nei deserti dell'impero Ottomano in disfacimento, ha cominciato a vivere.

programme.title: Grace is Gone
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo porta le figlie in viaggio prima di dir loro la verità

programme.title: Broken
programme.desc: Una giovane donna fugge dal suo passato e fugge in Inghilterra in cerca di una nuova vita. Accetta un lavoro per prendersi cura di un tetraplegico, ma il peso del lavoro agita il suo passato. Sembra che i limiti della cura non siano sempre così chiari come dovrebbero essere

programme.title: Il Nido dei Calabroni
programme.desc: Un serial killer terrorizza Charlotte, nella Carolina del Nord. Spetterà al capo della polizia Judy Hammer e alla sua vice, Virginia West, scoprire il colpevole prima che colpisca di nuovo.

programme.title: Equals
programme.desc: In un mondo futuro privo di avidità, povertà, violenza e sentimenti, una nuova malattia minaccia di risvegliare emozioni sopite in chi ne viene colpito, prima di essere allontanato dalla società e mai più rivisto. In tale contesto, Nia e Silas vivranno una relazione proibita.

programme.title: A Whirlwind Wedding
programme.desc: Darcy, una talentuosa organizzatrice di eventi, torna nella sua città natale per organizzare il matrimonio della madre. La donna ha difficoltà ad accettare il futuro patrigno e ben presto l'ossessione di Darcy per la perfezione inizia a scontrarsi con i desideri della madre di una festa sobria, soprattutto quando si tratta del bello e affascinante Kyle, lo chef che Darcy ritiene inadeguato per il catering dell'evento. Ma quando sorgono complicazioni, sia personali che professionali, è Kyle che riesce ad aiutarla a realizzare il grande giorno e a farle trovare l'amore che stava cercando...

programme.title: Innamorarsi a Whitbrooke
programme.desc: Ad una project manager viene offerta l'opportunità di trasferirsi a Londra. Ma quando torna nella sua città natale ed incontra l'uomo perfetto, la sua passione de il suo talento per la pittura si riaccendono, dandole una nuova visione della vita e dell'amore.

programme.title: Sono affari di famiglia
programme.desc: Un ex professore offre ad Adam un milione di dollari per ottenere del plasma dal laboratorio di una società di alta tecnologia. Adam chiede aiuto al nonno criminale. Riusciranno a convincere il ora onesto padre di Adam a unirsi?

programme.title: La madre sbagliata
programme.desc: Il sogno di Kaylene Larsen si è finalmente avverato: due bellissimi gemelli nati da una fecondazione in vitro. Ma quando Kelsey ha bisogno di assistenza domiciliare, l'infermiera che assume non è altro che lastessa donatrice di ovuli - e la pazza è venuta a reclamare i suoi bambini!

programme.title: Chiedi alla polvere
programme.desc: A Los Angeles della Grande Depressione si incontrano lo scrittore Arturo e la cameriera Camilla. Lui sogna di scrivere un romanzo, lei di sposare un uomo ricco e cambiare le sue umili sorti. Diversi per estrazione etnica e culturale, finiranno per innamorarsi in maniera del tutto inaspettata.

programme.title: Un matrimonio movimentato
programme.desc: Darcy, una organizzatrice di eventi, torna nella sua città natale per organizzare il matrimonio della madre. Tuttavia fa fatica ad accettare il futuro patrigno e ben presto la sua ossessione per la perfezione inizia a scontrarsi con il desiderio della madre di organizzare una cerimonia sobria.

programme.title: Maschile Singolare
programme.desc: Antonio è costretto a mettere in discussione tutte le proprie certezze quando viene abbandonato dal marito, dal quale dipende sia psicologicamente che economicamente. Deve quindi trovare una nuova casa, un lavoro e un nuovo scopo nella vita.

programme.title: Il segreto delle Api
programme.desc: La dottoressa Jean Markham torna nella città che aveva lasciato da adolescente per occuparsi dello studio del padre.

programme.title: Le pagine della mia vita
programme.desc: Quando Lisa torna nella sua città natale per cercare ispirazione per la sua nuova linea di moda, si ritrova ad aiutare la sua migliore amica a prepararsi alla nascita del primo figlio.

programme.title: Tutto su mia madre
programme.desc: Esteban è alla ricerca della sua parte mancante, il padre. Ma sarà la madre ad intraprendere il viaggio che la porterà a delle scoperte sconvolgenti.

programme.title: The whistleblower
programme.desc: Katryn Bolkovac, poliziotta del Nebraska divorziata e con una figlia adolescente affidata al marito, decide di fare richiesta per una missione dell'Onu in Bosnia. Siamo nel 1999 e le forze di pace controllano il territorio con l'aiuto di contractors della società britannica Democra.

programme.title: The Imitation game
programme.desc: Ritratto intenso e inquietante di un brillante e complesso uomo, THE IMITATION GAME mostra un genio che, sotto una pressione angosciante, ha contribuito a ridurre la durata della guerra e, quindi, a salvare milioni di vite.

programme.title: Amore inaspettato
programme.desc: Bill, scrittore di successo, resta cieco a causa di un incidente stradale, nel quale sua moglie perde la vita. Un giorno si presenta alla sua porta Suzanne, obbligata ai servizi sociali a causa di una condanna penale. All'inizio i due non si piacciono, ma ben presto si scopriranno innamorati.

programme.title: I consigli di zia Hope
programme.desc: Audrey si reca a Hope Cove per scrivere di una rubrica di consigli sull'amore speciale ma anonima. Mentre è lì, incontra il redattore capo, Morgan Cooper. Presto scoppieranno scintille tra di loro. Audrey sarà la protagonista della sua storia d'amore?

programme.title: Un matrimonio sotto lalbero
programme.desc: I genitori single Cadence e Henry non potrebbero essere meno simili, ma quando devono contribuire ai rispettivi progetti durante le festività natalizie, la chimica è innegabile. Con il Natale alle porte, riuscirà l'improbabile coppia a trovare l'amore che non sapeva di cercare?

programme.title: Crazy kind of love
programme.desc: Quando la famiglia Moon deve affrontare una nuova, inattesa gravidanza, i fragili equilibri domestici vengono completamente stravolti. Il padre scompare, la madre deve ritrovare la sua identità, e i figli adolescenti si ritrovano a crescere in fretta.

programme.title: Solo per lestate
programme.desc: Cercando di eludere gli sforzi delle loro nonne per organizzare matrimoni, due ex innamorati d'infanzia fingono di tornare insieme per l'estate.

programme.title: Lovers
programme.desc: Tradimenti, vendette, amori e colpi di scena animano quattro storie parallele interpretate dai medesimi attori sullo sfondo di Bologna. Amore, commedia, dubbio e sospetto si fondono nel film italiano pluripremiato all'estero.

programme.title: The Gods
programme.desc: In un moderno Romeo e Giulietta, Mikey James, un imbroglione cresciuto per strada con i suoi due fratelli, va a lavorare per la famiglia Fasano mentre cerca disperatamente di trovare una via d'uscita dal suo stile di vita frenetico.

programme.title: Sugar!
programme.desc: Leslie una casalinga e insegnante di pianoforte di oltre 50 anni decide di seguire il sogno della sua vita di essere una cantante rock 'n roll. Purtroppo questa sua decisione viene accolta con grande disappunto da parte del marito che che è in corsa per una carica politica.

programme.title: XX secolo
programme.desc: Un fiammante impresario di Broadway che è caduto in difficoltà cerca di convincere la sua ex amante, ora una diva di Hollywood, a tornare e far risorgere la sua carriera fallimentare.

programme.title: American Life
programme.desc: La storia di Burt e Verona, una coppia di trentenni che aspetta un bambino. La gravidanza procede bene fino a quando ricevono una notizia improvvisa e sconvolgente: gli eccentrici genitori di Burt annunciano che lasceranno il Colorado per trasferirsi in Europa. A questo punto, viene a cadere l'unica ragione per la quale avevano deciso di stabilirsi lì. Dove e vicino a chi dovranno mettere si casa per crescere il bambino in arrivo? I due ragazzi partono così per un viaggio che li porterà a far visita ad amici e familiari, in città diverse, per valutare tutte le possibili opzioni.

programme.title: La Sorgente dell'Amore
programme.desc: Leila, giovane sposa magrebina, propone alle donne del suo villaggio di fare lo sciopero dell'amore: niente più sesso finché gli uomini non porteranno l'acqua al villaggio. E alla fine le donne la spunteranno.

programme.title: La Città invisibile
programme.desc: La terra trema e il mondo non è più lo stesso. Tutto cambia. Cambiano i paesaggi, le persone, la vita. Dalle rovine de L'Aquila nasce nuova vita. Questo è ciò che accade a Luca e Lucilla. Entrambi vittime del tragico terremoto del 6 aprile 2009, i due studenti universitari scelgono di non abbandonare la città e nemmeno i loro sogni.

programme.title: È arrivata mia figlia!
programme.desc: Val, governante devota, vede il suo equilibrio cambiare quando la figlia Jessica arriva con le sue ambizioni. Un film vincitore al Berlinale e al Sundance che esplora temi di classe e disuguaglianza, con un'interpretazione straordinaria di Regina Casé.

programme.title: La Finestra di Alice
programme.desc: Gabriele, aspirante scrittore pieno di debiti, passa le giornate a spiare dalla finestra la bella dirimpettaia Alice. Non riuscendo a sostenere le spese per il lussuoso appartamento avuto in eredità, il giovane decide di affittare una stanza allo spagnolo Fabio. La convivenza fra i due si rivela piuttosto complicata perché i ragazzi si scontrano spesso per via di grosse diversità caratteriali, ma poco dopo nel palazzo di Alice avviene un omicidio e Fabio diviene il principale indiziato.

programme.title: Piovono Polpette
programme.desc: Basato sul delizioso libro illustrato di Judi e Ron Barrett, questo film d'animazione in computer grafica racconta la storia di una città chiamata Chewandswallow, dove il cielo provvede a tutti i pasti, che si tratti di pioggia di zuppa, neve di purea di patate o hot dog che soffiano a 10 chilometri all'ora. Purtroppo il tempo, come il latte acido, volge al peggio.

programme.title: Piovono polpette 2
programme.desc: Dopo la disastrosa tempesta di cibo scatenata da Flint, lo scienziato e i suoi amici sono costretti a lasciare la città. Flint accetta l'invito del suo idolo Chester V per unirsi alla The Live Corp Company, che è stata ingaggiata per ripulire l'isola, dove i migliori inventori del mondo creano tecnologie per il bene dell'umanità. Quando Flint scopre che la sua macchina è ancora in funzione e ora crea bestie mutanti fatte di cibo, capisce che è il momento di fare ritorno per salvare nuovamente il mondo

programme.title: Un Viaggio a Quattro Zampe
programme.desc: Un Viaggio a Quattro Zampe racconta l'avventura di Bella, un cane che intraprende un epico viaggio lungo 400 miglia per ricongiungersi con il suo amato padrone.

programme.title: Anno Uno
programme.desc: Una coppia di pigri cacciatori-raccoglitori bandita dal proprio villaggio primitivo intraprende un epico viaggio nel mondo antico.

programme.title: Mi faccia causa
programme.desc: Davanti al pretore Giovanni Pennisi transita tutti i giorni un campionario di varia umanità,

programme.title: Aragosta a colazione
programme.desc: Enrico fallisce il suicidio e finisce nei guai recitando la parte del marito per un amico

programme.title: Il marito in collegio
programme.desc: Carlotta sposa il benzinaio Camillo per l'eredità, ma lo manda in Svizzera per diventare raffinato.

programme.title: Arrivano i bersaglieri
programme.desc: 20 settembre 1870: i bersaglieri entrano a Roma tra uccisioni, amori e vendette sullo sfondo papale

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: La donna più bella del mondo
programme.desc: Gina Lollobrigida interpreta una donna affascinante e ambiziosa che cerca di farsi strada nel mondo dello spettacolo. Tra amori e tradimenti, la sua bellezza diventa sia un vantaggio che una trappola, esplorando la superficialità e le difficoltà della fama.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: Arrivano i dollari
programme.desc: Cinque fratelli scoprono che uno zio morto in Sudafrica ha lasciato loro in eredità una grossa somma. Ma solo liberandosi dei loro difetti potranno entrarne in possesso. Tutti cercano allora di mettersi in buona luce con la bellissima moglie dello zio cercando di ingannarla.

programme.title: Ghost Academy
programme.desc: Un professore tormentato da allucinazioni di persone defunte, ottiene una cattedra per insegnare a una classe di soli cinque studenti. Ma gli alunni sono fantasmi, morti da più di vent'anni.

programme.title: Sotto Il Cielo Delle Hawaii
programme.desc: Un famoso militare professionista ritorna sul luogo dei suoi più grandi trionfi legati al programma spaziale degli Stati Uniti a Honolulu, Hawaii. Qui incontra una sua ex, ma altrettanto inaspettatamente si innamora della giovane pilota dell'Air Force a lui assegnata.

programme.title: Il pretore
programme.desc: Varese, anni Trenta. Il pretore Augusto Vanghetta, interpretato da Francesco Pannofino, è un uomo potente e impunito che divide la vita tra tribunale e numerose amanti. Il suo mondo dorato entra in crisi quando il giovane assistente Mario finisce per insidiare proprio la sua trascurata consorte.

programme.title: Il testamento di Madigan
programme.desc: Il giovane Frank Putzu diventa un funzionario del Dipartimento del Tesoro statunitense. Apparentemente ingenuo e mite, viene inviato a Roma per recuperare una grossa somma di denaro dovuto al governo degli Stati Uniti da Mike Madigan, un mafioso morto.

programme.title: 10 Cose Da Fare Prima Di Lasciarsi
programme.desc: Ben e Abigail si conoscono a un appuntamento al buio in un bar e, per gioco, stilano una lista delle dieci cose da fare insieme prima di lasciarsi. Dopo aver passato la notte insieme, le cose prendono una piega inaspettata.

programme.title: Vacanze sulla Neve
programme.desc: Durante una settimana bianca si intrecciano le vicende e i flirt di alcuni giovani vacanzieri ospiti dello stesso hotel.

programme.title: Shaolin Basket
programme.desc: Shi-Jie viene trovato da bambino nella spazzatura e cresciuto in un'accademia di arti marziali. Arrivato all'università, entra nella squadra di basket e insegna il Kung Fu ai suoi compagni per far colpo sulla sorella del capitano della squadra!

programme.title: LErba Di Grace
programme.desc: Nel disperato tentativo di salvare la sua proprietà, Grace, una vedova inglese, decide di collaborare con un giardiniere e trasformare la serra di orchidee in una coltivazione di marijuana.

programme.title: Samoa, regina della giungla
programme.desc: Diretto da Guido Malatesta, con Edwige Fenech.Tra giungle inesplorate e pericoli nascosti, una coraggiosa regina guida il suo popolo contro invasori e tradimenti, tra azione e avventura.

programme.title: Lo Sceicco Rosso
programme.desc: Nel cuore del deserto, un misterioso sceicco guida ribellioni e intrighi tra tribù rivali e poteri coloniali, tra azione e colpi di scena. Diretto da Ferdinando Cerchio.

programme.title: Cyrano contro D'Artagnan
programme.desc: Tra duelli e intrighi di corte, Cyrano e D'Artagnan si affrontano e si alleano tra rivalità e onore, in un'avventura ricca di azione e spirito cavalleresco.

programme.title: La rivolta dei mercenari
programme.desc: In un territorio sconvolto dalla ribellione, un gruppo di spietati mercenari viene ingaggiato per reprimere una rivolta, ma tradimenti e ambizioni personali accendono una lotta feroce per il potere.

programme.title: Giubbe rosse
programme.desc: Cormack, l'uomo di legge più temuto dagli aspri pionieri all'inizio del secolo, ha un legame misterioso con "Caribou", un fuorilegge che ha imprigionato. Quando Caribou evade dalla prigione, ritorna per cercare vendetta.

programme.title: Le colline blu
programme.desc: Tre cowboy, scambiati per membri di una banda di fuorilegge, sono implacabilmente inseguiti da una squadra.

programme.title: Il tempo degli avvoltoi
programme.desc: Kitosch è accusato di un crimine che non ha commesso e si unisce a Joshua Tracy, un feroce fuorilegge. Quando Tracy rapisce e ricatta il suo ex datore di lavoro, Kitosch si riscatta salvandoli.

programme.title: All'ultimo sangue
programme.desc: Un libro paga dell'esercito viene derubato da Billy Gun. L'esercito assume Clive Norton per recuperare il denaro. Per aiutarlo, Norton salva dalla forca un uomo che disprezza particolarmente Gun. El Chaleco - Il fratello di Billy Gun

programme.title: Ramon il Messicano
programme.desc: Una terrificante storia di omicidio e vendetta che si svolge mentre Slim Baxter tenta di distruggere la terribile banda di Morales e salvare la sua adorabile sposa Esmeralda.

programme.title: Mani di pistolero
programme.desc: Per vendetta, il pistolero Dan rapisce il figlio dello sceriffo che ha ucciso il suo bambino.

programme.title: ...e poi lo chiamarono il Magnifico
programme.desc: Joe, che non ama la violenza, affronta il selvaggio West per esaudire l'ultimo desiderio del padre.

programme.title: 7 donne per i MacGregor
programme.desc: Derubati dal temuto bandito Maldonado, i fratelli MacGregor avviano una rischiosa caccia per recuperare il loro oro.

programme.title: Non toccare la donna bianca
programme.desc: La battaglia di Custer e la disfatta di Little Big Horn sono ambientate nella fossa delle Halles a Parigi.

programme.title: Un uomo e una colt
programme.desc: Un pistolero ingaggiato da un latifondista deve uccidere un medico sostenitore della rivoluzione.

programme.title: I Maestri Del Cinema: Billy Wilder
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi registi del XX secolo. Gli esordi, le difficoltà e infine i film e il cinema.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.13
programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: L'Ultimo Giorno Da Rockstar: Elvis Presley
programme.desc: Il documentario ripercorre la storia del re del pop, Elvis Presley, fino alla sua improvvisa morte nel 1977.

programme.title: Rock Legends
programme.desc: Scopri la vita e l'impatto culturale di queste leggendarie icone musicali, tra interviste e performance.

programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi attori degli ultimi 90 anni.

programme.title: Brigitte Bardot: the icon of France
programme.desc: Il racconto dell'ascesa al successo del mito di Brigitte Bardot, incarnazione della sensualità femminile.

programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: I Maestri Del Cinema: Billy Wilder
programme.desc: La serie che celebra i grandi registi del XX secolo. Gli esordi, le difficoltà e infine i film e il cinema.

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News Ep.13
programme.desc: Tutte le news che vi siete persi dalla redazione di HotCorn: tra ospiti, interviste e grandi novità al cinema.

programme.title: La battaglia degli imperi
programme.desc: 48 a. C. La Via della Seta è luogo di passaggio e di contesa tra popoli differenti per etnia e costumi. Il generale Huo An, un unno adottato e cresciuto da un generale cinese, è il custode della pace e del delicato equilibrio tra le 36 nazioni.

programme.title: Un Uomo e una Donna
programme.desc: Due sconosciuti all'area di raccolta di un campo per bambini a Helsinki sentono una scintilla di attrazione reciproca. Quando i loro figli se ne vanno, nasce un legame inaspettato.

programme.title: Moonlit Winter
programme.desc: Quando Sara scopre una lettera dal Giappone che rivela il primo amore di sua madre, decide di accompagnarla in un viaggio che cambierà per sempre il loro rapporto.

programme.title: Lupin III: Il film
programme.desc: Lupin III, nipote del celebre Arsenio Lupin, è universalmente riconosciuto come uno dei ladri più famosi del mondo, tanto da far parte ell'organizzazione The Works.

programme.title: Moose
programme.desc: Bertil incontra Moose, un alce che dice di essere caduto dalla slitta di Babbo Natale, ma c'è un problema.

programme.title: Striscia, una zebra alla riscossa
programme.desc: Nolan trova una zebra neonata e la regala alla figlia Channing, che sogna di addestrarla per il Kentucky Open

programme.title: Miss Potter
programme.desc: Londra, fine '800. Beatrix Potter, anticonformista, diventa scrittrice e si innamora dell'editore Warn
